settings.heading: Meet our ambassadors
settings.text: We don’t throw big paychecks at mindless athletes to simply wear our product or logo - we have teamed up with genuine humans, that just so happen to also be world class professional athletes that not only love our product but also embody our brand and care about the future of our sport.

settings.heading: Joel Dahmen
settings.overlay_description: FUN. SURVIVOR. GOLFER. Joel is an everyday man's pro - cancer survivor, small town hero and just so happens to be one of the most consistent players of this generation. Joel's on a mission to help end cancer, and we're proud to be on his team.

settings.heading: Chris Kirk
settings.overlay_description: FAMILY. GEORGIA. SHORT GAME. Chris came to TRUE out of necessity - searching for footwear that could free him from chronic foot pain. Apparently TRUEs did just that, helping Chris walk in comfort since 2012.

settings.heading: Ryan Moore
settings.overlay_description: With one of the most historic and decorated amateur records of all time, this TRUE Co-Founder has racked up quite the professional and personal life accomplishments. Father of 3, Ryan has five TOUR Wins, one Ryder Cup showing and stands at 31st on the all-time money list.

settings.heading: Mark Hubbard
settings.overlay_description: "Homeless Hubbs" switched to TRUE after his coach discovered how much more efficient his footwork became with our shoes on. Mark is best known as “Short Putter Guy” and Nick Faldo’s favorite PGA Tour Professional.

settings.heading: Taylor Montgomery
settings.overlay_description: Taylor is the most recent addition to team TRUE and we couldn't be more thrilled to have him on the squad. The UNLV graduate recently joined Tour in 2023 and we're eager to see him succeed in the coming years.

settings.heading: Ryan Brehm
settings.overlay_description: Ryan bought his first pair of TRUEs in 2022 and never looked back. Did the shoes help him win the 2022 Puerto Rico Open? Who's to say. But Ryan is an excellent golfer and human being that we're delighted to have on the team.

settings.heading: Dylan Wu
settings.overlay_description: Dylan bought his first pair of TRUEs at a lifestyle store while touring - and accidentally fell in love with the fit, feel and performance. A young PGA Tour player with a lot of promise, Dylan is set on becoming a PGA Tour player for life - and his skillset should prove that easy.

settings.heading: Oliver Wilson
settings.overlay_description: Oliver has been wearing the Original Series ever since he discovered the zero drop footwear. Helping spread the word globally, and specifically in the UK, Oliver is one of TRUEs biggest advocates and supporters as it looks to grow it's brand across the pond.

settings.heading: Parker McLachlin
settings.overlay_description: You might know him from his instructional videos on YouTube and Instagram, but Parker is more than his short game.

settings.heading: Christina Kim
settings.overlay_description: PERSONALITY. AUTHOR. ACTIVIST. Christina embodies the TRUE mantra, live TRUE - be yourself. After transitioning from metal spikes, TRUE was the only brand that provided ample tread and reduced slipping - and we're proud to be on her team.

settings.heading: Christina Kim
settings.overlay_description: PERSONALITY. AUTHOR. ACTIVIST. Christina embodies the TRUE mantra, live TRUE - be yourself. After transitioning from metal spikes, TRUE was the only brand that provided ample tread and reduced slipping - and we're proud to be on her team.

settings.heading: Madelene Sagström
settings.overlay_description: LPGA TOUR champion, a seasoned competitor in three Solheim Cups, and a distinguished 2020 Olympic athlete. Madelene has achieved remarkable milestones in the realm of golf and we're beyond grateful to have an athlete of this magnitude on team TRUE.

settings.heading: Sophia Popov
settings.overlay_description: From winning an LPGA Major to competing in the 2020 Tokyo Olympic games, Sophia has achieved many amazing things in her career. We're stoked to introduce the newest LPGA addition to team TRUE.

settings.heading: A TRUE Story
settings.text: Golfers have stories - but unfortunately most go unheard, until now. Joel sat down with us and shared every competitive player's worst nightmare with us...
settings.quote: “And my caddie says with all sincerity, that’s our last ball, don’t lose it".
settings.author:
Joel Dahmen
PGA TOUR Winner

settings.heading: Friend to All
settings.item_text: Come as you are - leave your costumes and pretentiousness at the door. All TRUE ambassadors welcome all to the sport we love.

settings.heading: Do Unto Others
settings.item_text: This isn’t complicated - golf teaches us common courtesies like raking bunkers, playing fast, not stepping in each others lines and TRUE ambassadors rep this.

settings.heading: Live TRUE
settings.item_text: Golf needs your personality. No more cookie-cutter athletes all wearing and saying the same things. Be yourself and the world will be better for it.

settings.heading: Enjoy The Game
settings.item_text: Golf is a sport about acceptance, camaraderie, and challenging yourself both on and off the course. Our Ambassadors are encouraging, supportive, and folks you'd like to spend time around.
